# rexdiff does not start when its input is wrong. Each error says what is
# wrong, and which values are allowed.

! exec rexdiff -layout sideways
stderr 'invalid value "sideways" for flag -layout: expected one of unified, split'
! exec rexdiff -scope=week
stderr 'invalid value "week" for flag -scope: expected one of uncommitted, branch, last-turn'
! exec rexdiff -bogus
stderr 'flag provided but not defined: -bogus'

# rexdiff needs a git repository.
! exec rexdiff $WORK
stderr '^rexdiff: not a git repository$'

# A bad configuration file names the file, the key, and the allowed values.
exec git init -q repo
env REXDIFF_CONFIG=$WORK/typo.toml
! exec rexdiff repo
cmpenv stderr typo.want
env REXDIFF_CONFIG=$WORK/value.toml
! exec rexdiff repo
cmpenv stderr value.want

# install rejects a wrong placement and an extra argument, and writes
# nothing.
! exec rexdiff install --placement=tabs
stderr 'unknown placement "tabs" \(use split, zoomed, tab, or overlay\)'
! exec rexdiff install extra
stderr 'unknown argument extra'
! exists .config/rex

-- typo.toml --
layuot = "split"
-- value.toml --
layout = "sideways"
-- typo.want --
rexdiff: config $WORK/typo.toml: unknown key "layuot"
-- value.want --
rexdiff: config $WORK/value.toml: invalid value for layout: expected one of unified, split, not "sideways"
